svg.title: Roller architecture
svg.desc: The host process loads and snapshots tasks, the Collector starts one Docker container or E2B sandbox per rollout, model calls pass through the request proxy, and the trace converters write samples to the run directory. roller import feeds local Claude Code and Codex sessions to the same converters without a container. The Viewer, training, bench reports and dataset exports read the run directory.
